Federation }} ====Group B==== =====The Club Africain v Croissant Chebbien match case===== On 18 April 2022, the match of the last round was held between [[Club Africain]] and [[Croissant Sportif Chebbien|Croissant Chebbien]] at [[Stade Olympique Hammadi Agrebi|Stade Hammadi Agrebi]], [[Tunis]] and ended with a 1–0 win for the hosts, a result that made [[Croissant Sportif Chebbien|Croissant Chebbien]] relegated to the [[Tunisian Ligue Professionnelle 2|Ligue 2]], but [[Croissant Sportif Chebbien|Croissant Chebbien]] protested the presence of [[Club Africain]] president, Youssef Elmi, on the bench despite his suspension from punishment by the [[Tunisian Football Federation|Football Federation]], and demanded that they would be given a penal victory, and they decided to take the case to [[Court of Arbitration for Sport|CAS]]. On 29 September, the [[Court of Arbitration for Sport|CAS]] decided to reintegrate [[Croissant Sportif Chebbien|Croissant Chebbien]] in the [[Tunisian Ligue Professionnelle 1|Ligue 1]], which forced the federation to add a 16th team for [[2022–23 Tunisian Ligue Professionnelle 1|2022–23]] season so that the number of teams would be even, and the identity of this team was determined by two playoff matches, the first between [[Club Sportif de Hammam-Lif|Club de Hammam-Lif]] and [[Espérance Sportive de Zarzis|Espérance de Zarzis]], and the second between the winner of the first match and [[ES Métlaoui|Étoile de Métlaoui]]. On 27 March 2023, the [[Court of Arbitration for Sport|CAS]] decided to give [[Croissant Sportif Chebbien|Croissant Chebbien]] a 2–0 penal victory. Since this decision affects the arrangement of the table in the first round and the added points for the coronation [[#Playoff|playoff]] and [[#Playout|playout]], and since this decision came late and after the start of the new season, the effect of this result in the second round was not calculated. =====Table before CAS decision===== {{#invoke:Sports table|main|style=WDL |section=Group B T1
